coordinates.Q: prospectively declared public action capability/admissibility, measured without using Y or route selection
coordinates.R: nominated implementation route availability/selection, including predeclared fallback
coordinates.G: directly measured local gate; vector-valued whenever more than one independently relevant component exists
coordinates.Y: public action success against one common oracle

required_interventions.name: Q_DROP
required_interventions.transition: Q:1->0 with R and G held by non-Y intervention

required_interventions.name: ROUTE_DROP
required_interventions.transition: R:1->0 with Q=1 and frozen fallback permitted

required_interventions.name: G_DROP
required_interventions.transition: one declared G component 1->0 with Q and R held

required_interventions.name: MATCHED_REPAIRED_STATE
required_interventions.transition: matched directly measured (Q,R,G), then compare Y

candidate_admissibility: exact upstream source revision and byte custody
upstream-supported feature, dispatch, or fallback control preferred
direct readout for Q, R, every relevant G component, and Y
common public oracle for baseline and all intervention arms
public action must remain measurable; performance-only differences are disqualifying
route loss cannot be relabeled as Q loss after seeing Y
